text: S647 screens a newly identified garment CAD candidate from first-party sources. Its manual documents ASTM/AAMA DXF input/output, and vendor materials advertise a free version and 15-day trial. Rights for this product-development evaluation and local handling of pattern files are not established. This is research only: no installation/account, vendor contact, file import, or V03 gate/hold change. See E-G04-S647-START.
